summary: Implemented the M2 PostgreSQL persistence foundation: SQLAlchemy 2.x models for users, organizations, memberships, sessions, service_identities, and audit_events; a single CREATE-only Alembic migration 0001 (no DROP/TRUNCATE/ALTER); DATABASE_URL-driven env.py; engine/session_scope/BaseRepository plus record-level OrganizationRepository/MembershipRepository and protocol-conformant SQLOrganizationStore/SQLMembershipStore behind the existing tenancy store Protocols; SQLite in-memory tests plus offline-SQL migration tests and DATABASE_URL-gated PostgreSQL tests; CI lane 5 wired to compose PostgreSQL; docs updated.
migrations: services/api/migrations/versions/0001_foundation.py (CREATE-only; downgrade intentionally not implemented per 07 no-destructive-ops policy)
contracts_changed: services/api/clipos_api/repository.py: Base, UserRecord, OrganizationRecord, MembershipRecord, SessionRecord, ServiceIdentityRecord, AuditEventRecord, get_engine, session_scope, BaseRepository, OrganizationRepository, MembershipRepository, SQLOrganizationStore, SQLMembershipStore

tests.name: pytest
tests.evidence: 136 passed, 1 skipped (PostgreSQL-gated migration test honestly skips without DATABASE_URL); coverage 88.81% vs 60% floor. Prior count 127; 9 tests + 1 PG-gated skip added.

tests.name: alembic_offline_render
tests.evidence: Exit 0; SQL saved to /tmp/clip010_upgrade.sql; renders CREATE TABLE for alembic_version plus users, organizations, memberships, sessions, service_identities, audit_events.

tests.name: ruff_format
tests.evidence: 3 files reformatted during iteration; final run: 29 files left unchanged.

tests.name: ruff_check
tests.evidence: All checks passed (3 import-order issues auto-fixed during iteration).

tests.name: mypy
tests.evidence: Success: no issues found in 13 source files.

tests.name: postgres_gated_tests
tests.evidence: Sandbox has no DATABASE_URL/Docker; the orchestrator must run CI lane 5 against compose PostgreSQL per packet.

known_limitations: Migration 0001 is CREATE-only with a no-op downgrade because 07 requires policy/backup validation for destructive ops; fresh environments start from an empty database.

Full Protocol conformance currently covers organizations and memberships (existing session/service-identity/audit in-memory stores remain active; SQL row models and migration support those tables now, service switching comes later).
PG migration idempotence and fresh-Postgres table checks are orchestrator-gated (DATABASE_URL in CI).
